extensions.name: Auto List
extensions.description: Smart list typing in the message composer: continue ordered (1., 1)) and unordered (-, *, +) lists automatically on a new line, break out with two newlines, and Tab/Shift+Tab to indent by 2 spaces — like modern editors. 在消息输入框中智能续写列表：有序（1.、1)）与无序（-、*、+）列表换行时自动续写，空项换行退出列表，Tab/Shift+Tab 按两空格缩进/反缩进。
